author: Blust, Robert
title: A Mussau vocabulary, with phonological notes
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 (sealang.net PDF; tables read from page images): phoneme inventory (§2.1, pp. 168-169), phonetics (§2.4, pp. 171-175), canonical changes (§3.1), regular unconditioned and conditioned changes from POc (§3.2.1, pp. 176-178), consonant grades (§3.2.2, pp. 179-180), Table 3 (p. 181) and irregular reflexes (§3.2.3, pp. 181-183). Blust writes POc in Grace's orthography, with *ns for Milke's *nj (n. 16, p. 203): his *mp, *nt, *nd, *d, *ŋk, *mpʷ, *j, *ns are Ross's *b, *d, *dr, *r, *ɡ, *bʷ, *c, *j. Appendix 1 (the POc etymologies, pp. 186-202) gives the examples cited by number.
